svg.text: mcring v1 — sheet 2/5: MCU: ESP32-S3-MINI-1U, straps, USB test pads, I2C pull-ups
net-label schematic generated by hardware/electrical/schematic_svg.py from mcring_v1.py — 18 parts on this sheet
grey pin numbers are to be VERIFIED against the datasheets; red = power net, green = GND, blue = signal, x = NC, grey 'spare' = free GPIO; dashed grey box + * = off-board part wired to the board
• IO21 CAM_PWR_EN (was IO19), IO43 RGB data (was IO20); IO19/IO20 = native USB test pads.
• IO33 LED_PWR_EN (PIN_RGB_PWR) with 4.7k pull-down: WS2812 rail off at reset and in deep sleep (was IO44/RXD0).
• IO26 = SPICS1 of the in-package quad PSRAM -> NC. IO33-IO37 are free on the N4R2 (octal PSRAM parts only use them):
• IO34 AMP_PWR_EN (PIN_SPEAKER_EN, 100k pull-down), IO35/IO36/IO37 I2S BCLK/LRCLK/DOUT to the optional MAX98357A (Outputs sheet).
• IO44 (RXD0) is the only spare GPIO (grey 'spare'; ROM pull-up at reset). IO45/IO46 straps left floating. Pin table VERIFY.
• I2C 4.7k pull-ups on SDA/SCL (DRV2605L 0x5A, LIS2DW12 0x18). EN: 10k + 1 uF. IO0: 10k + pad + DNP button.
• ANT1 (off-board): 2.4 GHz flex antenna on the module's u.FL receptacle (not a pad) — see README §5.
